pages.text: The automatic fisher does your fishing for you. Supply it with energy (FE), a fishing rod and bait that rod can use. It must sit one above a block of water (use it on still water to place it there); in the Nether it also works above lava. Lure makes it cast more often and Luck of the Sea helps the bait.
pages.title: Automatic Fisher

pages.text: Only RF (capacitor) and speed (hyperkinetic) upgrades work with the autofisher. RF upgrades enlarge its energy buffer and lower its energy use; speed upgrades make it faster.
